domain_description: Applied and theoretical mathematics spanning statistical analysis, linear algebra, calculus, probability theory, numerical methods, optimization, graph theory, cryptography, signal processing, and machine learning mathematics. Based on IEEE standards, NIST statistical guidelines, and established mathematical frameworks.
authority_sources: IEEE Standards for Floating Point Arithmetic (IEEE 754)
NIST SP 800-22 (Statistical Test Suite for Random Number Generators)
IEEE 1619 (Standard for Cryptographic Protection of Data on Block Storage)

engines.name: Statistical Analysis Engine
engines.function: Perform comprehensive statistical analyses including hypothesis testing, regression modeling, ANOVA, Bayesian inference, time series analysis, and experimental design with proper assumptions checking and effect size reporting.
doctrine_topics: hypothesis testing framework and p-value interpretation
experimental design DOE factorial and response surface
survival analysis Kaplan-Meier and Cox regression
statistical power and sample size determination

golden_queries.question: A clinical trial with 200 patients per arm shows a treatment effect of 5% absolute risk reduction (15% vs 10% event rate) with p=0.08. Calculate the power of the study, determine the sample size needed for 80% power at alpha=0.05, and discuss the clinical vs statistical significance.
required_elements: sample size formula for two proportions

golden_queries.question: Fit a multiple regression model to predict house prices using square footage, bedrooms, age, and neighborhood. The residual plot shows heteroscedasticity and the VIF for bedrooms and square footage exceed 5. Address these issues.

engines.name: Linear Algebra Engine
engines.function: Analyze linear systems, matrix decompositions, eigenvalue problems, vector spaces, linear transformations, and applications in data science, physics, and engineering using rigorous algebraic frameworks.
doctrine_topics: systems of linear equations and solution methods
positive definite matrices and Cholesky factorization
sparse matrix methods and iterative solvers
applications in PCA and dimensionality reduction

golden_queries.question: A 10000x500 data matrix has condition number 10^8. Explain the numerical implications for least-squares solution, compare SVD vs QR approaches, and propose regularization strategies.

engines.name: Calculus Engine
engines.function: Analyze differential and integral calculus problems including multivariable calculus, differential equations, vector calculus, complex analysis, and applications in physics and engineering.
doctrine_topics: partial differential equations classification and methods
vector calculus div/grad/curl and integral theorems
complex analysis Cauchy integral and residues

golden_queries.question: Solve the heat equation u_t = k*u_xx on a rod of length L with boundary conditions u(0,t)=0, u(L,t)=0 and initial condition u(x,0) = sin(3*pi*x/L). Derive the solution using separation of variables and discuss convergence.

engines.name: Probability Theory Engine
engines.function: Analyze probability distributions, stochastic processes, Markov chains, Bayesian networks, random variables, and limit theorems with rigorous measure-theoretic foundations where appropriate.
doctrine_topics: Markov chains transition matrices and steady state
Monte Carlo simulation and MCMC methods
order statistics and extreme value distributions

golden_queries.question: A call center receives calls at an average rate of 30 per hour. Model the number of calls in a 10-minute window, the time between calls, and the probability that the system (with 3 operators, each handling one call for an exponential mean of 5 minutes) has all operators busy.
required_elements: M/M/c queueing model Erlang C formula

engines.name: Numerical Methods Engine
engines.function: Analyze numerical algorithms for root finding, interpolation, numerical integration, ODE/PDE solvers, and error analysis with convergence guarantees and stability assessment.
doctrine_topics: iterative methods for linear systems GMRES/CG

golden_queries.question: Compare RK4 and implicit BDF-2 methods for solving a stiff ODE system with eigenvalues spanning from -1 to -10^6. Analyze stability regions, step size requirements, and computational cost per step.
required_elements: stability region plots for both methods

engines.name: Optimization Engine
engines.function: Analyze optimization problems including linear programming, convex optimization, integer programming, nonlinear optimization, metaheuristics, and multi-objective optimization using duality theory and KKT conditions.
doctrine_topics: linear programming simplex and interior point methods
integer programming branch and bound/cutting planes

golden_queries.question: A logistics company needs to minimize delivery cost across 50 warehouses, 200 customers, and 20 vehicles with capacity constraints, time windows, and mixed integer variables. Formulate the VRPTW and recommend solution approaches.

engines.name: Graph Theory Engine
engines.function: Analyze graph structures, network algorithms, connectivity, flow problems, coloring, matching, and applications in social networks, transportation, and computer science.

golden_queries.question: A social network has 10,000 nodes and 500,000 edges. Identify the most influential nodes using at least three centrality measures, detect community structure, and analyze small-world properties.
required_elements: average path length vs random graph

engines.name: Cryptography Engine
engines.function: Analyze cryptographic algorithms, security protocols, key management, hash functions, digital signatures, and post-quantum cryptography per NIST SP 800-57 and FIPS standards.

golden_queries.question: Compare the security levels, key sizes, and performance of RSA-3072, ECDSA P-256, and ML-DSA-65 (Dilithium) for a digital signature scheme that must remain secure for 20 years. Consider quantum threat timeline.

engines.name: Signal Processing Engine
engines.function: Analyze signal processing techniques including Fourier analysis, digital filtering, spectral estimation, wavelets, adaptive filtering, and compressed sensing for time series and spatial data.
doctrine_topics: Fourier transform DFT/FFT theory and applications

golden_queries.question: Design a digital bandpass filter for extracting a 1 kHz signal (bandwidth 100 Hz) from a noisy recording sampled at 44.1 kHz. Compare FIR (Parks-McClellan) and IIR (Butterworth) designs for filter order, latency, and passband ripple.
required_elements: IIR Butterworth design and bilinear transform

engines.name: Machine Learning Math Engine
engines.function: Analyze the mathematical foundations of machine learning including loss functions, regularization theory, kernel methods, information theory, PAC learning, and deep learning optimization landscapes.
doctrine_topics: loss function design and properties convexity
kernel methods and reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces

golden_queries.question: A neural network with 10 million parameters is trained on 50,000 samples and achieves near-zero training loss but 30% test error. Analyze through the lens of bias-variance tradeoff, VC dimension, and propose mathematically grounded regularization strategies.
required_elements: VC dimension analysis for overparameterized model
